source.title: Bounty Board launch: hosted preview, playtests, score policy and submission gates
source.body:
## Goal
Ship **the expanded post-js13k game**, not the frozen 13 KB competition ZIP, to Bounty Board Arcade with evidence from a real hosted preview and first-time players. PR #60 made CI test the exact upload archive; PR #62 added bounded competitive scoring; PR #63 added real keyboard/mouse browser acceptance. These all passed the exact merged `main` SHA `bbf76fd` on October 19, 2026. Neither automation nor a successful upload is proof of real host behavior.


## Completed technical release work
- [x] [PR #60](https://github.com/sidhulyalkar/unicorn-stampede/pull/60): exact ZIP integrity and main push Arcade qualification.
- [x] [PR #62](https://github.com/sidhulyalkar/unicorn-stampede/pull/62): finite separate ranked score and anti-farming invariants (0–99,500), unchanged campaign scoring.
- [x] [PR #63](https://github.com/sidhulyalkar/unicorn-stampede/pull/63): real Chrome/Firefox title, WASD, Q, mouse-Whip, Space, pause/resume qualification against extracted ZIP.
- [x] All three merged-main CI workflows green on `bbf76fd`; exact ZIP, screen captures and machine-readable QA included in the Arcade artifact.

## P0 release blockers
- [x] Verify fresh `main` Arcade, showcase and satisfaction workflows on the same SHA after PRs #60, #62 and #63. All three passed on `bbf76fd`.
- [ ] Download `unicorn-stampede-arcade-preview` from the newest green **Arcade showcase qualification** main run, including ZIP, manifest, 16:9 cover and screenshots. Confirm SHA-256 and ZIP root `index.html`.
- [ ] Create a free Bounty studio account and upload the **ZIP** (not the frozen js13k artifact) in private/test mode; select *Leaderboards* and set a reviewed score ceiling.
- [ ] **Signed-in host preview:** title load, true gameplayStart/Stop on start/pause/resume/tab switch, integer score updates, exactly one gameOver, cloud mastery saved and restored after refresh and signing out/in.
- [ ] **Guest host preview:** fully playable without localStorage, no cloud-save success claim, no SDK-related softlock or console errors.
- [ ] **Competition isolation:** Prismborough/Medium starts at zero with reproducible shared town; other modes/worlds are free-play and do not produce positive ranked scores; test score cap failures.
- [ ] **Complete a natural physical run:** v1.22 Chromium/Firefox verified actual title selection, WASD paint, Q switch, mouse Whip, Space Dash and P pause/resume from the packaged ZIP. Still require a complete **natural** ranked conquest and natural three-capture defeat/restart, without directly setting landmark HP/paint.
- [ ] **Validate ranked scoring in live play and host:** v1.21 replaced unbounded raw campaign points with finite milestone points (theoretical maximum **99,500**). CI proves raw-score manipulation and erase/repaint loops cannot increase the board directly. Sample completed-run distributions, confirm the Bounty score ceiling is **at least 99,500**, verify score rejection feedback, and audit unexpected strategies. Client scoring remains alterable by determined users, so avoid paid stakes until authoritative verification exists.
- [ ] Desktop QA in Chromium, Firefox and Safari where possible: music/SFX unlock, keyboard focus inside iframe, Escape/P/Q/Space, fullscreen, narrow viewport and page visibility changes.
- [ ] At least **five uncoached first-time testers**, 30-second attempt then playthrough: ≥80% can say the goal; median first successful Whip+Dash building smash ≤45 s; ≥80% understand TEAM count; no softlocks; capture/rescue comprehension and replay interest recorded. Fix actual observed points of confusion before extra mechanics.

## Listing and outreach
- [ ] 16:9 cover, ≥100-word description, controls, screenshots and a 20–40-second gameplay clip showing a herd handoff, multicorn demolition and the consequences of capture.
- [ ] Upload via https://www.bountyboard.gg/arcade/submit and verify private preview before requesting publication/review. Publication requires Bounty approval.
- [ ] Reply to Grant in existing Stretchicorn thread: confirm Stretchicorn submission interest, share https://js13kgames.com/games/unicorn-stampede and explain that the expanded four-world Bounty-ready build is being prepared. Share the actual Arcade play link only once approved/available.

## Shipping boundary
- Frozen: `release/js13k-2026-submitted` and Wavedash PR #56.
- Canonical showcase: `main`.
- Official instructions: docs/BOUNTYBOARD_SUBMISSION.md and docs/BOUNTYBOARD_ARCADE_PLAN.md.
- Integrations are optional; standalone game must always start if SDK fails.
